ingredients.name: wheat semolina (rava)
ingredients.function: the cracked endosperm left over from milling wheat into maida, sold south as "Bombay Rava". It cooks in four minutes, which is why it won

ingredients.name: green and red chilli
ingredients.function: the heat, in place of pepper and ginger

ingredients.name: refined vegetable oil
ingredients.function: tempering fat, chosen for price and neutrality

ingredients.name: onion, carrot, peas, beans, tomato, potato
ingredients.function: the modern vegetable set, several of which are post-Columbian arrivals

method_reconstructed: Roast rava, temper, add vegetables, pour in water and stir in the rava.
